ground_truth.cause: In batch, thumbnailer executes tail /dev/zero after 15 seconds. Reading an endless input into the tail buffer causes unbounded allocation against a 64Mi container limit.
ground_truth.impact: Thumbnailer is OOM-killed and restarts. The shop services do not depend on it; this does not establish node-wide memory exhaustion.
ground_truth.mitigation: Replace the unbounded read with bounded processing and deploy the corrected image, or stop thumbnailer as containment. Raising its memory limit alone only delays failure; verify bounded memory and stable execution.

causal_change.reason: This scenario does not provide a controlled introducing commit and recorded product access to its history.
